I am an old man here in Somali region, and life on this land is hard. The rains are not generous here, and I have no money to buy the chemical fertilizer from town — even if I did, without good rain it would only burn my maize. I keep some goats and cattle, so I will spread their manure on this small plot like my father did, and I will plant the seed I saved from last harvest together with some beans between the rows. My sons and I will do the work ourselves; I cannot pay anyone.
